name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the continuation is related to the context and the conversation flow.
scale: 1-5, with 5 being highly relevant and 1 being completely irrelevant

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the extent to which the continuation encourages further interaction and maintains the conversation.
scale: 1-5, with 5 being highly engaging and 1 being disengaging

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and uniqueness of the continuation, including the use of interesting facts or anecdotes.
scale: 1-5, with 5 being highly creative and 1 being unoriginal

name: Accuracy
description: Measures the factual correctness and appropriateness of the information provided in the continuation.
scale: 1-5, with 5 being completely accurate and 1 being incorrect or inappropriate

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and consistency of the continuation within the context of the conversation.
scale: 1-5, with 5 being highly coherent and 1 being incoherent
